HediffDef.label: ranged Replicator specialization
HediffDef.description: This Replicator lineage has learned to reproduce a compact ranged emitter from successfully assimilated turret or weapon technology.

HediffDef.label: heavy-armored Replicator specialization
HediffDef.description: This Replicator has reorganized its blocks into dense sacrificial armor learned from consumed protective technology. The additional mass makes it slower.

HediffDef.label: power-construction Replicator specialization
HediffDef.description: This Replicator carries a denser internal energy-routing lattice derived from consumed generators and power systems. It dismantles matter and reorganizes with nearby units more rapidly.

HediffDef.label: grav-mobile Replicator specialization
HediffDef.description: This Replicator has learned compact gravitic load-balancing from assimilated gravtech. It does not gain magical flight, but its low-hover support nodes make the body substantially faster and more mobile across ordinary terrain.

HediffDef.label: shielded Replicator specialization
HediffDef.description: This rare Replicator body carries a compact personal field derived from repeatedly assimilated shield technology. The field is finite, slow to recover under fire, and especially vulnerable to EMP.
